title: Control: victim-listing rows of an IoC table, IPv6 zero run defanged as one bracket

provenance.method: constructed from Need Review reports 35960 (HivePro 3AM 'Type | Value' IoC table ending in a 'Recent Breaches' row), 35968 (HivePro SafePay 'Recent breaches' sub-table with a 'Victim sites' row) and 35967 (HivePro UpdraftCentral 'IPv6 | 2a09[:]bac5[:]4e21[:]2e3c[::]49b[:]9'), using the publishers' own values
provenance.verified_by: construction + manual comparison with each publisher article
provenance.notes: Victim websites named in 'Recent Breaches' / 'Victim sites' rows are breached organizations, never Indicators; the bracketed IPv6 zero run is that address.
